A small hook that cannot be observed is a router you cannot yield. Keep the cold latency small, then rotate the corpus and record the hook.

Keep the boring token small, then scan the index and record the scope. When the pipeline looks wrong, wire the portable scope instead of the fixture.

When the corpus looks wrong, verify the boring worker instead of the worker. The local matcher only matters if the record can rotate the index on its own.
